episode_summary: This episode of Keeping It Real with Austin Clarence explores the introduction of the Vantage Score as a new tool for mortgage approval, offering potential advantages over traditional FICO scores. It also highlights opportunities for self-employed borrowers through profit and loss loans and discusses the untapped market of older home buyers. Austin provides actionable insights for real estate agents to leverage these changes to better serve their clients and expand their business.
